_note: Linux gVisor, checked in Docker (arm64) with runsc 20261005.0 and isobox 2145756 (tendant fork: c7bbd19 plus the scoped-read /bin fix). fs.read_scope limits reads to the granted and system paths. resource.pids is RLIMIT_NPROC set by the adapter's nproc shim (isobox's --pids caps only the Sentry's host threads). Not required: resource.memory (needs cgroup v2 delegation the hosted runner may lack), fs.virtual_paths (isobox has no /workspace remap).
